$description: Sail base design tokens (:root). SSOT — edit here, run generate.

frame.$description:
Control framing — an extra box-shadow "frame" drawn around controls, stacked BEFORE the variant's own shadow so it reads as chrome rather than elevation.
The no-op is a fully transparent shadow, NOT `none`: this value is composed into a comma-separated box-shadow list, and `none` is not a legal list member — `box-shadow: none, var(--shadow-xs)` drops the whole declaration. A zero-size transparent layer paints nothing and composes cleanly. Same reasoning for --press-shadow and the --glow-* family.

lift.$description: Interaction motion. The baseline button lift/press was decided once, globally, in the contract (`translateY(-1px)` / `translateY(1px) scale(0.98)`) — the whole product's personality in two literals. Routed through channels so a calm theme sets 0 and an arcade theme exaggerates. Defaults reproduce the historical values.

translate.$description: Interaction motion — see control.lift. Default reproduces the historical :active translate.

scale.$description: Interaction motion — see control.lift. Default reproduces the historical :active scale.

shadow.$description: Shadow applied on :active, composed on top of the control's resting shadow. Transparent no-op (see control.frame); an 8-bit theme gives it a hard offset that collapses on press.

toast-region-width.$description: Toast stacking region max width (panel family; was component.toast-region.width).

mono-app.$value: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

press-start-app.$value: "Press Start 2P", "Press Start 2P Fallback", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

transform.$description: Casing channel. The default is what the system ALREADY does, not a uniform `none`: headings render as authored. Governed property: `text-transform`.

Casing channel. The label role has always been upper-cased (hand-written `text-transform: uppercase` in every skin that carries a label), so the default is `uppercase` — defaulting to `none` would have quietly lower-cased every eyebrow and rail heading in the product. A channel is a seam, not a restyle. Governed property: `text-transform`.

displayFont.$description: Display type — the hero/wordmark role, themable independently of --heading-font. Default aliases the existing display stack so nothing moves.

width.$description: Stroke weight. Every hairline in the system lowers to this instead of a literal 1px, so a brutalist or 8-bit theme can thicken every control edge at once. Governed property: `border-width`.

cornerImage.$description: Corner treatment — a `border-image` value for controls and cards. Default `none` leaves `border-radius` in charge. A pixel-art theme supplies a slice so corners are drawn, not rounded. Governed property: `border-image`.

primary.$description: Gradient channel. This lived as a literal INSIDE the sx vocabulary's atom (text-gradient-primary), so a theme could restyle every colour in the system and still not touch its own wordmark. Lifted here; the atom now reads the channel. Default is the exact former literal, so this is a pure refactor until a theme opts in.

accent.$description: Gradient channel — a PROMOTION, not a new idea: two atoms wanted the same shape with a different base, so both now reference named globals instead of one being implicitly derived from the other.

surface.$description: A page-level gradient wash, painted under content by the surface reader. Nothing gradient-washes the page today, so `none` is both the no-op and the honest default.

primary.$value: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 8%, transparent), transparent 60%)
primary.$description:
Per-tone glow — a radial background wash keyed to the tone ramp names (see the tone ramps), so `--glow-{tone}` is addressable wherever `--tone-*` is. Defaults to the former bg-glow-primary literal.
NOTE: this is a BACKGROUND channel. A neon box-shadow rim (what a synthwave theme reaches for on controls) is --control-frame's job — one token, one meaning.

accent.$value: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 8%, transparent), transparent 60%)
accent.$description: Per-tone glow (see glow.primary). Defaults to the former bg-glow-accent literal.

shapePill.$description:
Pill sentinel — SPLIT from --radius-full.
--radius-full (9999px) was doing double duty: a shape token meaning "this element is a circle/pill" AND the top of the radius scale. A theme that squared off its radius scale had no way to say "…but intrinsically round elements stay round", because both meanings lowered to the same name. --shape-pill carries the SHAPE meaning; --radius-full stays in the scale. Elements that are intrinsically round (dots, avatars, spinners, switch thumbs) read --shape-pill.

default.$description: Card / panel fill. Themes remap this (was component.card.bg). Public name --card.
Floating panel fill. Themes remap this (was component.popover.bg). Public name --popover.

knob.$description: Light control knob (switch thumb). Not surface-1: muted ≈ surface-1 in dark modes, so a dedicated light face keeps track/thumb contrast.

page.$description: Document inset at the default (mobile) breakpoint. Theme picks a space step.

default.$description: Semantic default border (color + width + style). Color member aliases color.border.default so --border stays the paint token.

subtle.$description: Semantic subtle border composite. Color member aliases color.border.subtle (--border-subtle).

strong.$description: Semantic strong border composite. Color member aliases color.border.strong (--border-strong).

control-sm.$description: Control height step sm. Geometry only — pad is space.

control-md.$description: Control height step md. Geometry only — pad is space.

control-lg.$description: Control height step lg. Geometry only — pad is space.

full.$description: Fill the containing box (width + height 100%). Geometry only. Dies after size(grow)|size(max) migrate.

measure.$description: Default reading column. Language lowers width + max-width 100% so the box does not hug.

body.$description: Body type role. Aliases typography.body + text-base; does not invent a second scale.

body-sm.$description: Small body type role. Same family/weight as body at text-sm.

label.$description: Label / eyebrow type role. Includes case because typography.label owns transform.

heading.$description: Heading type role. Includes case because typography.heading owns transform.

mono.$description: Mono / code type role. Aliases typography.monoFont + text-sm + leading.code.

display-sm.$description: Small display type role. Aliases typography.displayFont + the 4xl scale step (largest fixed display step before the fluid hero).

mono-sm.$description: Small mono / code type role. Aliases typography.monoFont + text-xs + leading.code.

tagDefaults.$description: HTML tag → type role (SPEC-SPINNAKER-3 §10). Theme data, not CSS vars. Markup style() overrides. No heading-2 — the tag is the way. strong/b/a have no type default.

xs.$description: Elevation step xs. Shadow member aliases shadow.xs.

sm.$description: Elevation step sm. Shadow member aliases shadow.sm.

md.$description: Elevation step md. Shadow member aliases shadow.md.

lg.$description: Elevation step lg. Shadow member aliases shadow.lg.

xl.$description: Elevation step xl. Shadow member aliases shadow.xl.

none.$description: No elevation. Shadow member is the CSS none keyword.

surface.$description: Surface fill identity. Color member aliases color.surface.1 (--surface-1).

muted.$description: Muted fill identity. Color member aliases color.muted.default (--muted).

card.$description: Card fill face. Color member aliases color.card (--card).

button.$description: Button fill face. Host pack — delete after L1 retarget. Color member aliases color.background.

canvas.$description: Page/root face. Color member aliases color.background.

control.$description: Input/combobox face. Color member aliases color.input.

overlay.$description: Popover/menu face. Color member aliases color.popover.

foreground.$description: Foreground ink identity. Color member aliases color.foreground (--foreground).

muted.$description: Muted ink identity. Color member aliases color.muted.foreground (--muted-foreground).

card.$description: Card ink face. Color member aliases color.card.foreground (--card-foreground).

button.$description: Button ink face. Host pack — delete after L1 retarget.

canvas.$description: Ink on canvas. Alias of foreground during migrate.

on-surface.$description: Ink on surface. Color member aliases color.card.foreground.

on-control.$description: Ink on control. Color member aliases color.foreground.

toast-region.$description: Toast stacking region elevation (closed z scale; was component.toast-region.z).

card-backdrop.$description: Card backdrop-filter. Public name --card-backdrop-filter (skin still reads that var). Glass remaps to blur.

card-texture.$description: Card texture image. Public name --card-texture (themes remap; leftover/lint still name the var).

fade.$description: Opacity enter preset. Exit uses fade-out.

fade-out.$description: Opacity exit preset. Starts visible — does not pin rest at 0.

rise.$description: Translate-up enter without fading. Always-visible tiles stay solid on first paint.

press.$description: Scale-down on press. Does not fade the control out.

spin.$description: Full rotation. Loading marks spend this.

pulse.$description: Scale breathe. No opacity — looping opacity is a blink.

bob.$description: Small vertical bounce. Ambient dots and idle marks spend this.

eq.$description: Scale-Y bounce from the origin. Equalizer bars spend this.

colors.$description: Named play property-set: color-bearing CSS properties. Not a keyframe.

$value.property: color, background-color, border-color, outline-color, fill, stroke

control.$description: Wave 0 motion tier — controls hover/press (color + transform + shadow).

$value.property: color, background-color, border-color, outline-color, transform, box-shadow, opacity

surface.$description: Wave 0 motion tier — interactive surfaces (color + shadow + transform).

$value.property: color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow, transform, opacity
